command:
set -eu
marker="ANTRIEB_LOG_BASELINE_$(date +%s)"
logger -p user.notice -t retention-check "$marker"
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 10 ]; do
  if grep -F "$marker" /var/log/messages >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'boot_id=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
    rc-service syslog status
    grep -F "$marker" /var/log/messages
    stat -c 'messages_size=%s messages_mtime=%y filesystem_device=%d' /var/log/messages
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 1
  i=$((i + 1))
done
printf 'marker_not_found=%s\n' "$marker" >&2
exit 1

SYSLOGD_OPTS="-t -s 0"
/var/log/messages {
    daily
    rotate 14
    maxage 14
    missingok
    notifempty
    compress
    dateext
    create 0640 root wheel
    su root wheel
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /etc/init.d/syslog --quiet restart
    endscript
}
